iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised modular rogue trousers concept sheet for a medieval fantasy RPG, intended as a Tripo 3D modeling reference.
Input image: edit target, existing rogue trouser front/back sheet. Preserve its same single pair of empty trousers, proportions, stance, length, waistband height, two-view layout (FRONT left, BACK right), brown leather belt with simple brass buckle, compact leather pouches, tucked ochre linen sash, compact back-left rope coil with two keepers, knee repair patches, and open ankle hems.
Primary request: replace the modern denim/jeans appearance with convincing handwoven WOOL trousers for a worn medieval dungeon adventurer. Change cloth and trouser construction consistently in both views. Main fabric is subdued charcoal with a slight desaturated blue-gray cast: matte, soft, dense fulled wool, fine visible wool fibers and restrained coarse plain-weave texture, broad soft folds with natural weight. It must read unmistakably as WOOL, never as blue jeans. Remove the speckled stonewashed denim pattern, contrasting orange/yellow double topstitching, curved jeans fly outline, zipper fly, rivets, rear jeans yoke, and five-pocket jeans construction. Front center below sash should be simple uninterrupted wool with a discreet tonal seam; any waist closure is concealed beneath the sash. Use quiet irregular handsewn seams in matching dark thread. Both knee patches are worn dark umber leather attached with restrained hand stitches, readable as repair patches rather than modern kneepads. Slight dirt and edge wear without all-over denim-like scratches or bleaching. Preserve the ochre LINEN waist wrap and brown LEATHER accessories and their locations.
Composition: landscape sheet, exactly two views of the SAME trousers, equal scale, fully visible waistband to ankle, orthographic-like, margins, no body or mannequin. Keep similar silhouette, moderately roomy thighs and substantial calves with simple narrower final ankle hems that tuck into separate low boots. Keep all accessories above the hip crease. Soft even light for clear material readability; simple plain neutral warm-gray studio background.
Avoid: indigo denim, jeans, denim twill, stonewashing, acid washing, bright contrasting machine stitches, zipper, modern pockets, metal rivets, printed fabric, tactical details, added objects, weapons, dangling cloth, human skin, boots, text, labels, watermark. Preserve the front/back accessory consistency as much as possible.
